import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert is_takeaway to categorical variable
coffee_sales['is_takeaway'] = coffee_sales['is_takeaway'].map({0: 'In-store', 1: 'Takeaway'})

# Create a bar chart of the top 5 products by total sales
top_products = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['total'].sum().nlargest(5)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=top_products.index, y=top_products.values, order=top_products.index)
plt.title('Top 5 Products by Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a stacked bar chart of the top 5 payment methods by total sales
payment_methods = coffee_sales.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum().nlargest(5)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=payment_methods.index, y=payment_methods.values, order=payment_methods.index, hatch=['/', '\\', '+', 'x', None], alpha=0.8)
plt.title('Top 5 Payment Methods by Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Payment Method')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Payment Method', labels=['Cash', 'Credit Card', 'Debit Card', 'Mobile Payment', 'Other'])
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Create a pie chart of the distribution of customer age groups
age_groups = coffee_sales['customer_age_group'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,8))
plt.pie(age_groups.values, labels=age_groups.index, autopct='%1.1f%%')
plt.title('Distribution of Customer Age Groups')
plt.axis('equal')  # Equal aspect ratio ensures that pie is drawn as a circle.
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
